item.text: {"explanation":"Maintain the current version/value, historical acknowledgement, and a snapshot-request latch. Valid newer deltas and snapshots advance state and rearm the latch; conflicting newer information requests one snapshot until recovery.","mapping":"State fields v and x are current version/value, a is the historical acknowledged version, and l is the request latch. Each event produces the current fields plus zero or one snapshot effect.","assumptions":"Unknown or malformed events are ignored. Inputs satisfy the stated safe-integer and JSON constraints.","applies":"(input)=>true","holds":"(input,output)=>{let c=input.config,s={v:c.version,x:c.value,a:-1,l:false},e=input.events||[],r=[];for(let q of e){let f=[];if(q&&q.type==='delta'){if(q.base===s.v&&q.version>s.v){s.v=q.version;s.x+=q.delta;s.l=false}else if(q.version>s.v&&!s.l){f=[{type:'snapshot',base:s.v}];s.l=true}}else if(q&&q.type==='snapshot'){if(q.version>s.v){s.v=q.version;s.x=q.value;s.l=false}else if(q.version===s.v&&q.value!==s.x&&!s.l){f=[{type:'snapshot',base:s.v}];s.l=true}}else if(q&&q.type==='ack'&&q.version===s.v)s.a=s.v;r.push({version:s.v,value:s.x,acknowledged:s.a,effects:f})}return JSON.stringify(r)===JSON.stringify(output)}","program":"function solve({config,state,event}){let s=state?{v:state.v,x:state.x,a:state.a,l:state.l}:{v:config.version,x:config.value,a:-1,l:false},f=[];if(event&&event.type==='delta'){if(event.base===s.v&&event.version>s.v){s.v=event.version;s.x+=event.delta;s.l=false}else if(event.version>s.v&&!s.l){f=[{type:'snapshot',base:s.v}];s.l=true}}else if(event&&event.type==='snapshot'){if(event.version>s.v){s.v=event.version;s.x=event.value;s.l=false}else if(event.version===s.v&&event.value!==s.x&&!s.l){f=[{type:'snapshot',base:s.v}];s.l=true}}else if(event&&event.type==='ack'&&event.version===s.v)s.a=s.v;return{state:s,output:{version:s.v,value:s.x,acknowledged:s.a,effects:f}}}"}
